name: lc-districts-v1
_about: The fixed gameplay route for the Linux stutter A/B (route.py). From Star Junction east through Lancet
over the Algonquin Bridge to Rotterdam Hill, south through East Hook, back west over the Broker Bridge
to Fishmarket South and Chinatown, and north to the Cluckin' Bell in The Triangle; then on foot inside
to the counter, eat, and back out to the street, which is the end. About 3 km driven.
GTA IV 1.2.0.59 world units. Every leg stays on one side of the water, and a bridge is a leg of its
own: the AI plans only over path data streamed in around the player, so a target across a river sends
it to the shore. For the same reason every point is an exact car node, read once from the game
(GET_CLOSEST_CAR_NODE_WITH_HEADING) standing next to it, never snapped at run time ('road': true): from
far away the lookup finds a different node. Bridge nodes are in the lanes of the direction driven. The
leg after a bridge ends at the foot of its ramp (a car parked there once for two minutes).
'chinatown-north' is a point on the street the car turns into north of the Broker Bridge ramp (from
its recorded path, not a node lookup): tasked from the ramp straight to the Cluckin' Bell, the car
stood at that junction until the watchdog moved it, in every run. The Cluckin' Bell door and counter
